resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Takuzo Kinbara。6月10日，他和妻子正前往若叶台的寺庙，参加Tae的弟弟Katsuhiro Doigaki的二周年忌日法事。与此同时，他看到了Akira Kisugi。他要求Kisugi道歉，因为Kisugi骗走了他的钱，间接导致他杀死了Kisugi。两人发生了争执，然而Takuzo因注意到Esaka目击了两人而分心。Takuzo立刻认出了Esaka，但他被Kisugi拖进了一条小巷。他设法挣脱了Kisugi，但在这个过程中，他把Kisugi用力推到了墙上。导致Kisugi后脑受到撞击而死亡。Takuzo随后埋葬了Kisugi的尸体，认为不必担心Esaka目击到他。当Esaka突然从他住的街区消失后，他更加放心了。
resolution.en: The culprit is Takuzo Kinbara. On June 10, he and his wife were going to the temple at Wakabadai to attend the second anniversary death of Katsuhiro Doigaki, Tae's younger brother. At the same time, he saw Akira Kisugi. He demanded an apology from Kisugi, as he was responsible for indirectly killing Kisugi for conning him out of his money. The two struggled with each other however Takuzo was distracted after noticing that Esaka had witnessed the two of them. Takuzo immediately recognized Esaka, but he got dragged off by Kisugi into a alleyway. He managed to free himself from Kisugi, but in the process, he pushed Kisugi too hard into a wall. Causing Kisugi to die from receiving a blow to the back of his head. Takuzo later buried his body, thinking that he didn't need to worry about Esaka witnessing him. He was even more relieved when Esaka suddenly disappeared from his neighborhood.
